text: Figure 7.2: IPdu and signal layout The handling of the data inside COM’s IPdu buffer and the transformer buffer is shown in figure 7.2. The ISignalIPdu is handled by the COM module as ComIPdu and may contain several parts (signals and signal groups). A signal group in COM is represented by the ComSignalGroup container. In the System T emplate [7] it is possible to define that a signal group shall be han- dled by the COM Based T ransformer.
